notes: The ten non-maximum-choice validation failures remain unchanged; metrics exclude all six versions of each affected question.
Scores use 2428 complete successful questions, not the full 2437-question cohort used by the other models.

10966 successful predictions are reused from jev-run-001 for identical input records. Earlier successful results retain their original configurations; config and source_hashes describe the final implementation.
State truncation removes early string content cumulatively and can also shorten role/name/ID fields; fixed instructions and candidate options remain unchanged.
Length errors reduce the estimated input budget by 1024 per retry from 30720. Jev probability-sum validation uses option_count * 0.005 + 1e-12 without renormalization.
The initial 2000-question Jev evaluation remains a separate historical result.
